title: dump-refs
summary: Diagnostic that dumps every ref in a file together with its enclosingsymbolid attribution
intro: Read this when a reference-derived answer (callers, doc facts, unused-symbol findings) looks wrong: dump-refs prints every ref in one file with the symbol each was attributed to. Troubleshooting tool; needs a project index (--db).

surfaces.usage: drag-lint dump-refs <file> --db PATH (diagnostic: refs + enclosing_symbol_id attribution)
help: drag-lint dump-refs <file> --db PATH   (diagnostic: refs + enclosing_symbol_id attribution)
